required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 31 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous REWORK_REQUIRED round correctly identified as decision_20260709_context_manifest_sync_v1?
Is the current blocking issue specifically closeout artifact inconsistency, not context/manifest functionality?
Does live run_closeout_result.json initially show IN_PROGRESS or otherwise stale/partial closeout state?
Does live run_closeout_execution_log.json initially lack the full closeout step transcript?
Does the implementation avoid modifying User Solve files?
Does the implementation avoid reverse_solving, Web, tool provider, database, cleanup, deletion, archive compaction, workflow, and roadmap work?
Were current_state.json and task_packet.json left untouched?

Were artifact_index.json, negative_results.json, roadmap/workstreams.json, domains, frontend, workflows, solve_reports, training materials, archives, deletions, blob_store, and databases left untouched?
Does command_plan.json exist and pass for this rework round?
Does command_plan.json include run-closeout and close-round?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Does pytest_result.txt record an explicit pytest command and exit code 0?
Does pytest include tests/test_project_gate.py?
Does execution_log.json carry the current decision_id, round_id, and report_id?
Does execution_log.json record all command-plan required commands?
Does run_closeout_result.json end with closeout_status=PASSED for this rework round?
Does run_closeout_result.json contain executed_steps for the closeout pipeline?
Does run_closeout_result.json contain a close_round_result with close_status=CLOSED or equivalent current closed state?
Does run_closeout_execution_log.json contain the complete closeout transcript rather than only the initial start/preflight blocks?
Does final_gate_result.json pass for this rework round?
Does final_gate_result.json no longer contain active close_round_in_progress / final_check_after_archive_passed=false / empty close_round_close_status evidence for this rework round?
Does final-check after archive pass or otherwise accurately record closed archive status?
Does round_manifest exist for round_20260709_context_manifest_sync_closeout_artifact_rework_v1?
Does round_manifest agree with live reports and final_gate status_summary?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, tests_ran, generated_artifacts, and closeout evidence?
Does the report body explicitly explain how the previous closeout inconsistency was resolved?
